newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev eases to 1,590-1,610 per dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev eases to 1,590-1,610 per dollar.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev eased to 1,590-1,610 per dollar around 1200 GMT from the morning's 1,560-1,580 due to a rise in dollar demand on the local interbank market, dealers said.
"Clients started bidding for relatively small dollar volumes and the lev is some 30 off morning levels," a dealer said.
But the market was calm and no sharp lev fall was expected unless foreign currency demand rose further, traders said.
Around 1215 GMT the dollar was bid at 1,560-1,580 levs and was offered around 1,600-1,620. -- Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 981 8569; 981 4145
